title: add file mode parameter to handle .toml config files in flask.Config.…

comments.author: RonnyPfannschmidt
comments.body:
this parameter is a absolute lie - when true you take away the text and drop a buffer

this should be called `binary`

and it should use the open mode
comments.label: issue
comments.rationale: The new parameter's meaning is inverted: text=True actually switches to the binary buffer, so the API lies to its callers.

comments.author: davidism
comments.body:
This should change what `open` does, not try to access `buffer` after the fact (someone else pointed out this wasn't documented as a public API).

Also, it's backwards, `text=True`, the default, should result in a text file, `False` should result in a binary file.
comments.label: issue
comments.rationale: Reaches for the undocumented f.buffer after opening in text mode instead of choosing the open() mode, and the flag is backwards.
